selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: At the start of the passage, what things are named from creation?
questions.answer: The sun, the moon, the day, the night, the sky, the earth, and the human self.

questions.question: How is Allah described in that English meaning?
questions.answer: As Merciful and Compassionate.

questions.question: Which hides the sun’s light from view?
questions.answer: The night.

questions.question: What does the speaker ask the listener to understand a little about?
questions.answer: Why the world exists, why people were created, and the mystery of the prayers.

questions.question: Is the comparison long or short?
questions.answer: It is short.

questions.question: What is the listener asked to consider to learn about these things?
questions.answer: A brief comparison.

questions.question: Besides riches, what abilities did the king have?
questions.answer: Great skill, wide knowledge, and deep learning.

questions.question: What did the king want to make visible to people?
questions.answer: The greatness of his kingdom and the wonders of what he had.

questions.question: Why would the king also want others to look at them?
questions.answer: So they would be seen from other points of view too.

questions.question: What is said about the earth?
questions.answer: It is spread out wide.

questions.question: What shining thing is named after the sun?
questions.answer: The moon.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the earth’s shape or spread?
questions.answer: It is laid out broadly.

questions.question: What kinds of knowledge did the king have?
questions.answer: Many amazing sciences and many branches of learning.

questions.question: What three big topics is the listener invited to understand a little about?
questions.answer: The purpose of the world, the creation of people, and the reality of the prayers.

questions.question: In the example story, what did the king own in large amount?
questions.answer: Treasures and precious jewels.

questions.question: What is the other reason the king wanted the exhibition?
questions.answer: To see those qualities through the view of others.

questions.question: What did the king prepare so people could see his greatness?
questions.answer: An exhibition with displays.

questions.question: What does this tell us about the king?
questions.answer: He wanted his beauty and excellence to be known and seen.

questions.question: What opening words in Arabic are followed by an English meaning about Allah?
questions.answer: The words that mean beginning in Allah’s name.

questions.question: Which comes after the sun in the list of signs?
questions.answer: The moon.

questions.question: What does the night do about the sun?
questions.answer: It covers it.

questions.question: What is one reason the king wanted the exhibition for himself?
questions.answer: To look at his own beauty and perfection.

questions.question: Why would the king want to look at his own beauty and perfection himself?
questions.answer: Because he wanted to behold them directly.

questions.question: What are the two ways the king wanted beauty and perfection to be seen?
questions.answer: By seeing them himself and by seeing them through other people’s view.

title: 11 Word Introduction to the Parable and the Sultan's Purpose
